description: This file defines the TlsClientAuthenticationOptions class, which encapsulates configuration options for TLS client authentication, including certificate selection, protocols, revocation mode, and target host, using underlying SslClientAuthenticationOptions.

classes.name: TlsClientAuthenticationOptions
classes.description: Encapsulates TLS client authentication settings, wrapping SslClientAuthenticationOptions and providing properties for certificate selection, protocols, revocation mode, and target host.

methods.name: LocalCertificateSelectionCallback
methods.description: Gets or sets the callback used to select the local client certificate during TLS handshake.

methods.name: ClientCertificates
methods.description: Gets or sets the collection of client certificates used for authentication.

methods.name: EnabledSslProtocols
methods.description: Gets or sets the SSL protocols enabled for the connection.

methods.name: CertificateRevocationCheckMode
methods.description: Gets or sets the mode for checking certificate revocation.

methods.name: TargetHost
methods.description: Gets or sets the target host name for the TLS connection.

methods.name: SslClientAuthenticationOptions
methods.description: Provides access to the underlying SslClientAuthenticationOptions object.
